Excaliself v0.6.0 is out: sign in with Google, Microsoft, or your own OIDC provider (Authentik, Keycloak…).

Also new since launch: import from Excalidraw+, a shared team library, and an MCP server so AI clients can read and create drawings.

https://excaliself.com/docs/
